q_en: A capacitor with a capacitance of 10 μF is connected in series with a 1 MΩ resistor. How much time will it take for the capacitor to reach 90% of its final charge?
e_en: Time constant τ = RC = 10⁶ × 10 × 10⁻⁶ = 10 s. Charge reaches 90% when e to the power (−t/τ) = 0.1, so t = τ × ln 10 = 10 × 2.303 = 23.03 s. So the answer is 23.03 seconds.
